description: Says whether a call your team placed reached the person (picked up or not), as the lead card's call row does, and re-decides the lead's status from it. reached: true a person picked up, false nobody did (a greeting, a menu, no answer). Only a call your team placed (outbound) can be corrected, and true needs a call the phone system says connected. call_id from read calls. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat changes nothing more.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: correct_call_outcome
title: Correct a call's outcome
